comment: How scripts/conformance-reports.mjs runs each implementation. Build the adapter first (see its README). env values may use ~ for the home directory. notes are hand-written and shown, labelled as such, on the implementation's page.

notes: The kit doesn't cover parsing, validation, coercion or schema validity yet. graphql-js is checked against those references by the differential scripts, which document where it departs from the draft: [lexer and parser](../scripts/differential-lexer.mjs) (`KNOWN`), [validation](../scripts/differential-validation.mjs) (`DISCREPANCIES`), [coercion](../scripts/differential-coercion.mjs) (`KNOWN`) and [type system](../scripts/differential-type-system.mjs) (`VALIDATION_DEVIATIONS`).
Behaviour outside the kit's fixtures is described in the README's [What graphql-js does](../README.md#what-graphql-js-does).

The kit doesn't cover parsing, validation, coercion or schema validity yet. graphql-js is checked against those references by the differential scripts, which document where it departs from the draft: [lexer and parser](../scripts/differential-lexer.mjs) (`KNOWN`), [validation](../scripts/differential-validation.mjs) (`DISCREPANCIES`), [coercion](../scripts/differential-coercion.mjs) (`KNOWN`) and [type system](../scripts/differential-type-system.mjs) (`VALIDATION_DEVIATIONS`).
Behaviour outside the kit's fixtures is described in the README's [What graphql-js does](../README.md#what-graphql-js-does).
The subscription finding is described in the [adapter's README](../adapters/graphql-java/README.md#known-graphql-java-deviation).
The adapter uses async-graphql's dynamic schema API (`async_graphql::dynamic`). The derive-macro API may behave differently. See the [adapter's README](../adapters/async-graphql/README.md).

The sheet runs the adapter with `--idle`, which claims `idle` by waiting for .NET's thread pool to go quiet: runtime behaviour, not something Hot Chocolate promises. The kit's determinism replay passed, and a run without `--idle` (grace-based, random runs only) found the same failures. See the [adapter's README](../adapters/hotchocolate/README.md).
